About Super Cinematic

Super Cinematic is a movie hub in the same spirit as a streaming home page: what's playing right now, what's coming up next, and the films from the last ten years that are actually worth your time. No endless scroll of filler — just the releases, the dates, and the box office, kept straight.

Right now the story of the season is December 18, 2026: Marvel's Avengers: Doomsday and Denis Villeneuve's Dune: Part Three opening on the very same day. Pick a side — or do the double feature.

Release dates and box-office figures checked November 4, 2026, from Entertainment Weekly's 2026 release guide, Rotten Tomatoes' holiday preview, Metacritic's release calendar, and Box Office Mojo. Top 10 is an editorial ranking weighing awards, box office, and lasting impact, in line with critics' decade lists.

About the photos: every movie card carries a real photograph from Wikimedia Commons — public-domain and Creative Commons licensed images, free for anyone to use — picked to evoke each film's world: the Trinity test site for Oppenheimer, a carrier jet for Top Gun: Maverick, Tokyo Tower for Godzilla, moonlight on the ocean for Moonlight. Official studio posters and movie stills are the studios' copyrighted property, so Super Cinematic doesn't use them. Photo credits: Wikimedia Commons contributors, via commons.wikimedia.org.
